text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Construction of the sauna went smoothly, and both the sauna hut and hammocks were completed.
All that was left was to wait for the grand opening.

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's a wrap on filming for today!
Once we turn on the stove tomorrow, it's all done!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Once it opens, will the general public
be allowed in as well?

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Don't know if they'll actually show up...
but we're totally ready to welcome them!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, it'll be fine. The video's recording properly and all. Can't wait for the opening.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
So that'll take care of all sorts of things, then.
choice_data_list: What's with the sudden emotional tone?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, no real reason.
It kind of felt like a secret base, and I liked it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A log cabin smelling of fresh wood...
The chirping of insects outside...
Its detached atmosphere, far from everyday life, felt wonderful.
choice_data_list: Let's enjoy the secret base to our heart's content one last time.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds good.
Shall we get excited one last time?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I have a suggestion right off the bat.
There's a movie I've been recommending lately.
Mind if I put it on?
choice_data_list: Oh, before that, I kinda want to make some cup noodles.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trai-chan, you're a genius!
Super awesome. Let's totally do that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she put on was a faded old movie.
The screen flickered, the audio crackled—
and that occasional static was surprisingly soothing.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Mountain roads really are great, aren't they?
All those puffy cumulonimbus clouds billowing up...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, exactly, the view's great too,
and you can just shout 'Yahoo!' at the top of your lungs...
choice_data_list: They kind of remind me of us.
They kind of look like us, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, totally. Screaming on a mountain path?
That was literally us the other day. lol.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"We've really done all sorts of things
since coming here, haven't we?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wanna look through our photos so far?
You took quite a few too, Trai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hooked up my smartphone to the TV,
played music on an old radio,
and looked through the photos I'd taken so far.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each and every captured moment.
Memories of days gone by.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Combined with the raspy pop songs,
the photographs looked just like a movie.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, the photos ran out, and the footage cut off.
Only the leisurely music from the radio continued to play.
choice_data_list: I guess this is where the credits roll.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Starring Trai-chan, co-starring yours truly. What a fantastic movie that was.
choice_data_list: It's the other way around. You're the lead, and I'm the supporting actor.
It's the other way around. You're the lead, and I'm the supporting actor.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: No, no, no way.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: No, no, no.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's sad to see these everyday moments come to an end.
Yet, I feel a sense of fulfillment that I gave it my all.
Starting tomorrow, everyday life is bound to be wonderful too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Let's take a bunch more photos, look back on them like this, and chat some more, okay?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's cherish this new everyday life together
Yeah. Let's treasure our new everyday life together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With only the sound of slurping soggy cup noodles
and an old radio playing,
time slowly drifted by...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As time passed,
everyday life at Tracen Academy resumed.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hey Trainie, check this out.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Check out the comments.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Playing in the river instead of a cold bath is the absolute best!’
‘I could sleep in this hammock forever~’"
choice_data_list: A comment from someone who actually went there...!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Building it by the river and setting up
the hammocks were both huge hits, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Our little scheme worked like a charm, huh?
Hehehe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We laughed together for a while as we read the comments.
I'll cherish the memories of those days
in my heart forever.
